title: Whisper vs ElevenLabs
subtitle: Local whisper.cpp vs ElevenLabs Scribe — same 8s clip, side by side
brief: Dogfood of the user-chosen transcription engine feature (DDR-164): the caaftv-mixzone-8s clip transcribed twice — local whisper.cpp (ggml-base multilingual, no key, segment-level) and the dev server's ElevenLabs Scribe cloud route (key resolved server-side). Each artboard plays its own video copy and lists its own SRT cues, click-to-seek. Straight quality comparison, not production subtitle UI.
